egg-covered-fixed-trace-thickness-geomet.limitations: These assets preserve all original vertices including the mid-layer, exact inner/outer triangle identities, canonical surface P2 coordinates, mass/COM/inertia, and original six physical initializer anchors. The2-layer asset is the original NPZ byte-for-byte. Only internal layer count/basis changes; no new CAD projection, rounding, contact law or load radius is introduced. Internal meshes are not claimed per-parent nested simplicial partitions. Canonical trace identity is not yet an actual reconstructed collision-mesh equivalence or accepted contact state: subsequent producer/source/force/full-field qualification must verify those scopes. Existing64 initializer controls, five dynamic steps and all physical budgets remain required.

egg-covered-fixed-thickness-actual-trace.scope: Reconstruct actual IPC surface meshes for fixed-boundary thickness controls without solving elasticity.
egg-covered-fixed-thickness-actual-trace.limitations: The actual existing quadratic boundary subdivision and IPC interpolation reconstruct each volume mesh's contact trace. Body coordinates are matched bijectively to the original compact trace; coincident finger vertices retain distinct identities. Geometry, triangles, groups and lumped areas match, and zero/affine IPC source displacements are checked. The interior basis and interpolation source column count change with thickness. No stiffness, constitutive response, contact-force/state,64-control initializer or five-step dynamics is solved or accepted by this geometry-only check.

egg-cad1920-record-initializer-v1.scope: Resolve matched original two-jaw controls on declared CAD or fixed-polyhedron egg geometry.
egg-cad1920-record-initializer-v1.limitations: Original actual finger geoms, physical held points/components, material/density, friction, actuation, timestep and force budgets are preserved. CAD and polyhedral models have their explicitly measured different represented volume/mass. Five states are a short diagnostic, not a complete application/history or converged contact reference. Every saved state still requires independent force/global-field auditing. Geometry, bulk, contact integration and regularization axes, models/feedback and verified accuracy/cost remain open.

egg-cad1920-record-initializer-v1-audit.scope: Independently verify every precision-aware spatial state and its unaveraged global field.
egg-cad1920-record-initializer-v1-audit.limitations: Every original dynamic step is independently reconstructed, including exact previous-state/velocity integration, unsmoothed centered normal/friction stencils, mass/armature and capped jaw PD. Raw global wide-coordinate field bounds remain visible. The original fixed-arm/two-jaw control and saved held initializer remain explicit. Full-arm application matching and physical spatial/contact/geometry convergence are separate incomplete requirements.

egg-cad1920-record-initializer-fields-v1.scope: Compare all saved paired-reference arrays and full stress fields without a new solve.
egg-cad1920-record-initializer-fields-v1.limitations: Complete saved histories are compared at identical physical inputs and byte-identical geometry. By default initializer bytes must match; the explicit resolved-initializer option instead checks every initializer array at the original state budget and retains its measured difference. Independent force-audit results are checked and retained, not reassembled in this field comparison. This proves numerical equivalence only for these saved states; it establishes neither physical convergence nor a controlled timing improvement or warmed production cost.

egg-cad1920-record-initializer-all64-aud.scope: Independently reconstruct every recorded original held initializer's static forces and complete nonlinear fields.
egg-cad1920-record-initializer-all64-aud.limitations: Independent static reconstruction uses every actual friction predecessor, the original held-coordinate map, constant gravity, static capped proportional jaw effort and original1e-8m friction mollifier. Complete1e-9N held-force gates remain unchanged; six body support reactions remain explicit and are not treated as free-body residuals. Fresh constitutive contraction, every corner/quadrature tensor and raw whole-volume bounds cover all64 controls. These are audits of recorded producer states, not new solves or accepted spatial/contact/pressure/history/model/feedback/cost convergence.

egg-continuous-traction-load-axis-v1.scope: Qualify the original continuum traction law, then compare boundary integration on one fixed finer mesh without solving elasticity.
egg-continuous-traction-load-axis-v1.limitations: This load-only boundary-integration study keeps the existing physical centres, radius, compact profile, strengths, friction and normal/shear law unchanged. It first reproduces every original coarse nodal force at the original quadrature level using the unchanged original law source. On identical finer geometry it integrates that law on each current facet at three declared levels, retaining full nodal vectors and all physical quadrature arrays plus independent force/moment and quadratic-work checks. Frozen original-sample loading and newly integrated continuous-profile loading define distinct numerical load functionals. No stiffness/mass matrix or elasticity solve is assembled here. Small load changes or preserved total wrench do not certify stress accuracy; complete independent force/RHS/tensor/probe/peak/energy solves are still required before using this study as a physical convergence result.
